title: ComfyUI-LongCat-Avatar wrapper released by PedroMarinhoDev
summary: PedroMarinhoDev released a ComfyUI integration for LongCat-Avatar 1.6, enabling local character portrait lip-sync generation through modular node pipelines.
research_notes:
Clone or install the custom node repository into the ComfyUI/custom_nodes directory and install Python dependencies.

Download the LongCat-Avatar model checkpoint weights and Whisper audio encoder into the designated ComfyUI models folders.

Load the LongCat Avatar workflow graph, connect a single character portrait image and a target speech audio file to the node inputs.

Execute the generation queue using distilled 8-step sampling for rapid rendering or the auto-extend loop for longer audio tracks.

Use clean, noise-free speech audio with clear pronunciation to ensure accurate Whisper feature extraction and precise mouth synchronization.

Apply positive text prompts describing stable framing and clothing to constrain undesired camera motion or posture shifts across multi-frame sequences.

For audio longer than single-clip duration, use auto-extend windowing with overlapping frames to maintain temporal consistency and prevent boundary seam artifacts.
